The '''Crystal Dagger''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be obtained from the treasure chest on floor 60 in [[The Mines]]. It can also be purchased for {{Price|4500}} from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after reaching floor 60 in [[The Mines]].
